text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since our outing went long, the Mejiro 
family arranged an invitation for me to 
join dinner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good work today! Good evening, Ramonu-san, 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oops... are you feeling a bit nervous, 
Trainer? I get it. Totally get it~ until 
you get used to it, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nodded honestly with a wry smile. Just 
as she pointed out, I'm not used to dining 
at luxury hotels.

text_block_list.name: Hotel Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon the interruption while you're 
conversing. I am the general manager of 
this hotel. Allow me to extend my warmest 
welcome to you.
choice_data_list:
(The manager went out of his way to greet 
us...!?)

text_block_list.name: Hotel Manager
text_block_list.text:
Today, we have prepared a menu tailored 
specifically for athletes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "I see. I shall look forward to it, then."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I marvel, "So that's a thing..." a 
beautiful ceramic plate is placed before 
me. ...Is this, perhaps, a serving dish?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's a stand for putting food on. Sort 
of like a cafeteria tray, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Everything's so elaborate, isn't it! I 
totally get why you want to look all 
around!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I thought I was watching secretly, but 
it seems it was completely obvious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I took a deep breath to calm down 
a bit... a man in chef's whites walked 
over.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Male Head Chef
text_block_list.text: Buona sera! Good evening!

text_block_list.name: Hotel Manager
text_block_list.text:
This is our head chef. He wished to offer 
his personal greetings to the Mejiro 
family.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Male Head Chef
text_block_list.text:
It is a great honor to meet you! I will 
make it with all my heart and sincerity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —No, that will not be necessary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Buon vino fa buon sangue. ...All I desire 
is the finest vino.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How about you? Will you... satisfy me?

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Male Head Chef
text_block_list.text: Haha! ――Agli ordini, mia regina!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, the chef gently took her 
hand... and lightly brought it to his 
lips.

text_block_list.name: Ryan & Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wah. ...Woah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I expect something worthy of such loyalty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind a splendid, snappy wink, 
the chef dashed back into the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...'Good liquor makes good blood,' wasn't 
it? Ramonu-san truly is something else~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You looked sooo cool! Like a scene 
straight out of a manga—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was thrilling. That relaxed smile, 
her straight posture, and the flawless way 
she carried herself... It's burned into my 
mind—
choice_data_list:
(...If I'm going to stand beside Ramonu, I 
have to do the same)

(...If I'm going to stand beside Ramonu, I 
have to do the same)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking her as my example, I straightened 
my posture. —It might be just a quick fix, 
but I wanted to get even a little closer 
to the ideal.

text_block_list.name: Hotel Manager
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for visiting us today. 
To commemorate this evening, here is a 
small gift for all of you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Tickets to the stage play...?

text_block_list.name: Hotel Manager
text_block_list.text:
"A friend of mine is in the performance, 
you see. Please do drop by our shop again 
when you're looking for a place to chat 
after the show."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It was a truly meaningful evening. ...Has 
the car been brought around front?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Explaining that she had business and would 
head back separately, Mejiro Ramonu 
gracefully stood up. I scrambled to my 
feet as well—
choice_data_list: I'll walk you to your car.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Ryan & Palmer
text_block_list.text: So cool~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, Ramonu-san really is in a league of 
her own! Even as family, my heart is 
pounding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The elegance of Mejiro Ramonu captivated 
even her own kin. Once again, her 
bewitching presence was keenly felt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No, thank you, young man.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No, thank you, young lady.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She left. I wonder what she meant by 
that last part?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Ah, Trainer, you've got a smudge on 
your sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're right. Is this the main sauce?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't really complain about being 
treated like a kid here. ...I quietly 
vowed to get my revenge someday.
